analysis.title: Dividend screener (weekly update, 23 November 2026)
key_insights: UBS CIO screens all CIO Selected stocks with 2026/27E dividend yield of 3.5% or more, dividend per share growth of at least 3%, and dividend cover of at least 1 for both 2026 and 2027. Yields are based on consensus estimates and are not guaranteed.
The list is sorted by currency (A-Z) and then by 2026E yield. Names span Europe, Asia ex-Japan, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Latin America and North America.

Highest 2026E yields: Jiangxi Copper 10.56% (HKD), Volkswagen Preference 7.89% (EUR), Energy Transfer LP 7.36% (USD), FIBRA UNO 7.20% (MXN), WDP 6.91% (EUR), Kingboard Laminates 6.78% (HKD), Ping An H-shares 6.75% (HKD).

Largest 2027E dividend growth: Kingboard Laminates 75.7%, Shengyi Technology 51.8%, Samsung Electronics 49.7%, Santos 45.6%, Foxconn Industrial Internet A 44.5%, Weichai Power 27.3%, Erste Group 26.3%.

The screen is heavy in banks and insurers (HSBC, Lloyds, Barclays, ING, ABN AMRO, Chinese state banks, Malaysian and Thai banks, AXA, Allianz, NN Group), plus European utilities (Engie, Enel, Naturgy, Veolia) and telecoms (Orange, Deutsche Telekom, KT, SK Telecom).

Very high cover marks stand out: Repsol 6.0x for 2026E, BP 4.3x, China International Capital Corp 5.2x, China Pacific Insurance 4.2x, Samsung 4.1x. Low cover near 1.1x to 1.2x for FIBRA UNO, WDP, Wharf REIC, Keppel DC REIT, H&M, AIS.
Effective 1 November 2026 UBS CIO no longer rates equities as Most Preferred or Least Preferred. It now uses a non-rating CIO Selected designation, which does not set a price target.
Recent list changes: many names moved to CIO Selected on 5 Nov 2026 (Asia New Economy Leaders), and on 31 Oct 2026 Energy Transfer and Enterprise Products were added to US Energy.

risk_factors: Yields are based on consensus estimates and are not guaranteed.
The currency shown is not necessarily the dividend payment currency.
CIO Selected is a designation, not a rating, and status may change after publication.
Names with dividend cover near 1.1x to 1.2x have little payout buffer.
